t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The participant said that the colour of the gnomes and the baskets are related and there's a pattern to figure out and pay attention to.

vb_textbox.text: Initially I paid attention to the colours but didn't really notice any correlation. I think the best bet would be to focus on the multipliers, and choosing a specific gnome based on that. So, when there's a 5* multiplier, always go left/right depending on which gives the best outcome. Then sticking to that side when it reappears.Completely biased opinion here, but the red gnome is giving serious mixed signals and I'd personally avoid them at all costs.
